test_cases.objective: Verify the integrity of data migrated from the mainframe to the cloud platform using checksum verification.
prerequisites: Access to legacy and cloud systems

test_steps.action: Extract a sample dataset from the legacy mainframe system.
test_steps.expected_result: Dataset extracted successfully with no errors.

test_steps.action: Generate checksum for the extracted dataset.
test_steps.expected_result: Checksum generated successfully.

test_steps.action: Load the dataset into the cloud platform.
test_steps.expected_result: Dataset loaded successfully with no errors.

test_steps.action: Generate checksum for the loaded dataset.
test_steps.expected_result: Checksum generated successfully.

test_steps.action: Compare checksums of the extracted and loaded datasets.
test_steps.expected_result: Checksums match, indicating data integrity.

acceptance_criteria: Checksums of extracted and loaded datasets match

test_cases.objective: Validate the reconstruction and preservation of audit trails in the cloud platform using immutable storage.
prerequisites: Immutable storage configured in cloud platform

test_steps.action: Extract a sample audit trail from the legacy mainframe system.
test_steps.expected_result: Audit trail extracted successfully with no errors.

test_steps.action: Load the audit trail into the immutable storage in the cloud platform.
test_steps.expected_result: Audit trail loaded successfully with no errors.

test_steps.action: Verify the integrity of the loaded audit trail using cryptographic signatures.
test_steps.expected_result: Audit trail integrity verified successfully.

test_steps.action: Compare the loaded audit trail with the extracted audit trail.
test_steps.expected_result: Audit trails match, indicating successful reconstruction.

acceptance_criteria: Loaded audit trail matches the extracted audit trail
Audit trail integrity verified

test_cases.test_name: Verify Checksum Verification During Data Migration
test_cases.objective: Ensure that checksum verification is performed during the extraction, transformation, and loading of legacy records to maintain data integrity.

test_steps.action: Extract a sample set of records from the legacy system.
test_steps.expected_result: Records are successfully extracted with checksums generated.

test_steps.action: Transform the extracted records using the migration tool.
test_steps.expected_result: Records are transformed without altering the checksum values.

test_steps.action: Load the transformed records into the cloud platform.
test_steps.expected_result: Records are loaded successfully with checksums verified.

acceptance_criteria: All checksums match before and after migration
No data corruption detected

test_cases.test_name: Validate Parallel Run Mode and Reconciliation Reporting
test_cases.objective: Verify that the parallel run mode functions correctly and reconciliation reports demonstrate ≥ 99.99% data match.

test_steps.action: Enable parallel run mode for a subset of records.
test_steps.expected_result: Both legacy and cloud systems process the records simultaneously.

test_steps.action: Generate reconciliation reports for the processed records.
test_steps.expected_result: Reconciliation reports are generated without errors.

test_steps.action: Compare the reconciliation reports for data match.
test_steps.expected_result: Reconciliation reports demonstrate ≥ 99.99% data match.

acceptance_criteria: Parallel run mode functions correctly
Reconciliation reports show ≥ 99.99% data match

test_cases.objective: Verify that data migrated to the cloud platform matches the legacy mainframe system during parallel run mode with ≥ 99.99% accuracy.

test_steps.action: Execute parallel processing of 10,000 sample records in both systems
test_steps.expected_result: Both systems process identical input datasets without errors

test_steps.action: Run reconciliation report comparing output from both systems
test_steps.expected_result: Report shows ≥ 99.99% data match across all fields

acceptance_criteria: All critical data fields match between systems
No unexplained discrepancies in key quality records
Reconciliation report meets 99.99% accuracy threshold

test_cases.objective: Validate that historical audit trails are accurately reconstructed in the new cloud platform with immutable storage.

test_steps.action: Select 1000 audit trail entries from legacy system for verification
test_steps.expected_result: Sample set represents all significant event types and time periods

test_steps.action: Compare cryptographic hashes of migrated vs original audit entries
test_steps.expected_result: 100% hash match for all selected entries

acceptance_criteria: All critical audit trail elements preserved
No alterations to event sequence or timestamps
Immutable storage properties verified

test_cases.objective: Verify the integrity of migrated data by comparing checksums of legacy and cloud-stored records.

test_steps.action: Generate checksums for legacy data records.
test_steps.expected_result: Checksums are successfully generated for all legacy records.

test_steps.action: Generate checksums for cloud-stored data records.
test_steps.expected_result: Checksums are successfully generated for all cloud-stored records.

test_steps.action: Compare legacy and cloud checksums.
test_steps.expected_result: Checksums match for all records, indicating data integrity.

acceptance_criteria: All checksums match between legacy and cloud records

test_cases.objective: Validate the reconciliation reporting functionality during the parallel run mode.

test_steps.action: Generate a reconciliation report from the legacy system.
test_steps.expected_result: Reconciliation report is successfully generated.

test_steps.action: Generate a reconciliation report from the cloud system.
test_steps.expected_result: Reconciliation report is successfully generated.

test_steps.action: Compare the reconciliation reports.
test_steps.expected_result: Reports demonstrate ≥ 99.99% data match.

acceptance_criteria: Reconciliation reports demonstrate ≥ 99.99% data match

test_cases.objective: Verify that the reconciliation report generated during parallel run mode demonstrates ≥ 99.99% data match between legacy and migrated systems.

test_steps.action: Execute parallel run for a representative dataset (minimum 100,000 records).
test_steps.expected_result: Parallel run completes without errors and generates reconciliation report.

test_steps.action: Analyze reconciliation report for data mismatches.
test_steps.expected_result: Report shows ≤ 0.01% mismatch rate across all data fields.

acceptance_criteria: Reconciliation report demonstrates ≥ 99.99% data match
All mismatches are documented and justified

test_cases.objective: Validate that all historical audit trails are accurately reconstructed in the immutable object storage with cryptographic integrity.
prerequisites: Migration tooling configured for audit trail transfer
Reference audit trail extracts from legacy system

test_steps.action: Select 1000 random audit trail entries from legacy system for verification.
test_steps.expected_result: Sample set represents all significant event types and time periods.

test_steps.action: Verify cryptographic signatures and content hashes for selected entries.
test_steps.expected_result: All entries match legacy records with valid cryptographic proof.

acceptance_criteria: 100% of sampled audit trail entries match legacy records
All cryptographic proofs are valid and unbroken
No gaps in timestamp sequences

test_cases.objective: To validate the freeze, cutover, and rollback procedures ensuring they are executed correctly and approved as per URS-030-005.

test_steps.action: Initiate freeze procedure on the legacy system
test_steps.expected_result: Legacy system enters freeze state with no further data modifications allowed

test_steps.action: Execute cutover procedure to migrate data to the cloud platform
test_steps.expected_result: Data successfully migrated with no errors reported

test_steps.action: Simulate rollback procedure
test_steps.expected_result: System reverts to pre-cutover state with data integrity maintained

acceptance_criteria: Cutover completed within 48-hour window
Rollback successful with no data loss

test_cases.objective: To verify that reconciliation reports demonstrate ≥ 99.99% data match between legacy and migrated systems as per URS-030-012.

test_steps.action: Generate reconciliation report comparing legacy and migrated data
test_steps.expected_result: Report generated successfully with no errors

test_steps.action: Analyze reconciliation report for data match percentage
test_steps.expected_result: Data match percentage ≥ 99.99%

acceptance_criteria: Reconciliation report shows ≥ 99.99% data match

test_cases.objective: Verify that all audit trails from the legacy system are accurately migrated and stored in immutable object storage as per URS-030-003 and URS-030-015.

test_steps.action: Extract a sample of 1000 audit trail entries from the legacy system.
test_steps.expected_result: Sample audit trail entries are successfully extracted with metadata intact.

test_steps.action: Compare checksums of migrated audit trails in cloud storage against legacy samples.
test_steps.expected_result: 100% of checksums match between legacy and migrated audit trails.

test_steps.action: Attempt to modify a migrated audit trail record through standard interfaces.
test_steps.expected_result: Modification attempts are blocked by immutable storage controls.

acceptance_criteria: All sampled audit trails match checksums between systems
Immutable storage prevents modifications as designed
No data loss detected in migration process
data_integrity_requirements: ALCOA+ compliance for all migrated records

test_cases.objective: Validate that the parallel run mode produces accurate reconciliation reports showing differences between legacy and new systems as specified in URS-030-004 and URS-030-012.
prerequisites: Both legacy and new systems operational
Test dataset loaded in both systems

test_steps.action: Execute 50 identical transactions in both legacy and new systems during parallel run.
test_steps.expected_result: All transactions complete successfully in both systems.

test_steps.action: Generate reconciliation report through system interface.
test_steps.expected_result: Report generates within defined service level agreement timeframe.

test_steps.action: Verify report shows ≥ 99.99% data match for all test transactions.
test_steps.expected_result: Reconciliation report meets specified accuracy threshold.

acceptance_criteria: Reconciliation reports generated for all test transactions
Report accuracy meets 99.99% threshold requirement
All discrepancies properly documented

test_cases.objective: Verify that all audit trails from the legacy system have been accurately migrated to immutable object storage with no alterations.
prerequisites: Completed migration of audit trail data
Access to both legacy and migrated audit trails

test_steps.action: Select a random sample of 100 audit trail entries from the legacy system.
test_steps.expected_result: All selected entries are present in the migrated system with identical timestamps, user IDs, and actions.

test_steps.action: Attempt to modify a migrated audit trail entry via system interface.
test_steps.expected_result: System prevents any modifications to the audit trail entries in immutable storage.

acceptance_criteria: 100% of sampled audit trail entries match between legacy and migrated systems.
No modifications to audit trail entries are possible post-migration.
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trails must be complete, accurate, and immutable.

test_cases.objective: Validate that the parallel run mode generates accurate reconciliation reports between legacy and migrated systems.

test_steps.action: Execute a transaction in both legacy and migrated systems during parallel run mode.
test_steps.expected_result: Transaction is processed identically in both systems.

test_steps.action: Generate a reconciliation report for the executed transaction.
test_steps.expected_result: Report shows 100% match between legacy and migrated system outputs.

acceptance_criteria: Reconciliation reports demonstrate ≥ 99.99% data match between systems.
All discrepancies are documented and investigated.
data_integrity_requirements: Data must remain consistent between legacy and migrated systems during parallel run.

test_cases.test_name: Validate Immutable Object Storage for Audit Trails
test_cases.objective: Verify that audit trails are stored in immutable object storage to ensure data integrity and compliance with regulatory requirements.

test_steps.action: Initiate the migration process for audit trails.
test_steps.expected_result: Audit trails are successfully extracted from the legacy system.

test_steps.action: Load the extracted audit trails into immutable object storage.
test_steps.expected_result: Audit trails are stored in immutable object storage without modification.

acceptance_criteria: Audit trails are stored in immutable object storage
Checksum values match pre and post migration

test_cases.test_name: Verify Zero-Downtime Deployment with Blue/Green Pattern
test_cases.objective: Ensure the migration process supports zero-downtime deployment using a blue/green pattern to minimize system disruption.

test_steps.action: Deploy the migrated system in the green environment.
test_steps.expected_result: Green environment is operational with migrated data.

test_steps.action: Switch traffic from the blue environment to the green environment.
test_steps.expected_result: Traffic is successfully routed to the green environment with no downtime.

acceptance_criteria: Zero downtime during deployment
Green environment handles traffic without errors

test_cases.objective: Verify that all audit trails from the legacy system have been migrated to immutable object storage without alteration.

test_steps.action: Select a statistically significant sample of audit trail entries from the legacy system.
test_steps.expected_result: Sample audit trail entries are successfully retrieved from the legacy system.

test_steps.action: Compare the selected audit trail entries with their counterparts in the new immutable storage.
test_steps.expected_result: All sampled audit trail entries match exactly between legacy and new systems.

acceptance_criteria: 100% of sampled audit trail entries must match exactly between systems
No evidence of tampering or modification during migration
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trails must be preserved exactly as in legacy system
Immutable storage must prevent modifications post-migration

test_cases.objective: Validate that the reconciliation reports generated during parallel run mode accurately identify all discrepancies between legacy and new systems.

test_steps.action: Introduce 10 known discrepancies between legacy and new systems (e.g., modified records, missing data).
test_steps.expected_result: Test discrepancies are successfully created in test environment.

test_steps.action: Execute reconciliation reporting process and analyze results.
test_steps.expected_result: Reconciliation report identifies all 10 introduced discrepancies with accurate details.

acceptance_criteria: Reconciliation report must detect 100% of introduced discrepancies
Report must provide sufficient detail to investigate each discrepancy
regulatory_basis: GAMP5 Appendix D4 - Verification of migrated data
data_integrity_requirements: Reconciliation reports must be complete and accurate
Discrepancy details must be sufficient for investigation
